events.verdict: Jackson Jr. (MIL) is beaten to the spot but the body contact during Schroder's (BKN) drive is marginal.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) cleanly blocks the shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex.
Claxton (BKN) wraps both arms around Antetokounmpo (MIL), affecting his FOM.
Johnson (BKN) legally contests Middleton's (MIL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Portis (MIL) briefly applies a hand to Schroder's (BKN) front but the contact does not affect his SQBR. He then cleanly blocks Schroder's driving shot attempt and the ensuing contact is incidental.
Portis (MIL) legally contests Johnson's (BKN) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) inadvertently steps on Claxton's (BKN) foot and loses his balance as a result of the incidental contact.
Johnson (BKN) clamps and holds Middleton's (MIL) arm, which affects his ability to control the rebound.
Jackson Jr. (MIL) reaches across Schroder's (BKN) front, initiating illegal contact that allows him to get to the ball.
Schroder (BKN) commits a take foul on Lillard (MIL).
Antetokounmpo (MIL) legally contests Johnson's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Finney-Smith (BKN) commits a take foul on Lillard (MIL).
Wilson (BKN) commits a take foul on Antetokounmpo (MIL).
